meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Exa 做联网搜索和网页抓取:搜索走关键词加语义检索,可限定为研究论文并过滤学术域名;抓取能取回网页、文章和学术 PDF,支持一次处理多个链接。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、查询资料,或抓取、提取某个 URL 的内容时接管;技术科学类问题会优先学术来源。

say.text: 搜索近三年关于这个主题的论文，只要 arXiv 和 Nature 的
say.note: 用研究论文分类加学术域名白名单

say.text: 提取这个链接的正文内容：<URL>
一次把这三个 URL 的内容都抓下来

howto.what_en: Claude gains web search and page extraction through Exa: keyword plus semantic search that can be biased to research papers and filtered by academic domains, and fetching of webpages, articles, and academic PDFs, including several URLs in one call.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search, look something up, or fetch/extract a URL's content; technical and scientific queries are steered toward academic sources.

say_en.text: Search for papers on this topic from the last three years, only arXiv and Nature
say_en.note: Uses research-paper category plus domain allowlist

say_en.text: Extract the body content of this link: <URL>
say_en.note: Fetches a single webpage or PDF

say_en.text: Fetch the contents of all three of these URLs at once
